en: You know me well. Thank you so much!

en: What a lovely thought.

en: Thank you for the thought, though it is not quite for me.

da: Tak. Du må gerne spørge, hvad jeg kan lide en anden gang.
en: Thank you. You can ask what I like another time.

en: A birthday is lovelier with visitors.

en: Today is my birthday. Will you keep me company?

en: A little breeze arrived.

en: A neighbour passes by.
